high_level_description: The image depicts an art installation set in a dimly lit room with a minimalist design. The primary focus is on a central object that appears to be a large, dark, irregularly shaped rock or stone. This rock is suspended in the air by a network of thin, white strings that radiate outward from it, creating a web-like structure. On either side of the rock, there are two long, horizontal light tubes emitting a bright blue light. These lights extend horizontally across the room, adding a striking contrast to the otherwise subdued lighting.
